releasePolicy: All gates must pass for one complete release. Never replace reference output to make candidate output pass.

gates.requirement: Pinned aliases, generic families, selected TTC indices, weight/style, no missing glyphs; all four Fourier SVGs
SVG and PDF vector artwork, selectable text, transparency, clipping, gradients and bounded filter rasterization
All projected inline kinds, marks, links, references, mixed scripts, fallback shaping and CJK wrapping
Frozen legacy baselines for all profiles; fonts, front matter, paragraphs, lists, headings, floats, footnotes, columns and running furniture
Long tables, repeated headers, wrapping, sizing and tagged header associations without clipped or lost rows
Supported math corpus, indexed roots, operators, scripts, stretchy delimiters, equation numbering and MathML
Correct bidi, ligatures, diacritics and actual copying in Acrobat and Firefox PDF.js, plus Poppler extraction
Strict independent PDF/UA-1 and PDF/UA-2 validation; tags, language, reading order, alternatives, table headers, links and MathML
PDF runtime, installation, validation, release and deployment require no Python; independent consumer is retained
Pinned npm binaries and licensed fonts for Linux glibc x64/arm64, macOS x64/arm64 and Windows x64; offline clean installs
Bounded inputs, no network or path escapes, malformed asset rejection, cancellation, exclusive output creation and cleanup
0.5 aggregate CPU, 512 MiB, no swap, five warmups and thirty uncached observations per profile, p95 below five seconds on fixed fixtures
